name: BRAND TEXT
description:
McCoy Sauna and Steam is in the market of making saunas and steambaths for wellness clubs and home use since 1964 and is considered to be one of the experts in this niche. A wide variety of amenities and various home saunas include the Infrared Heat Therapy units that are capable of helping with a number of health problems.



High quality materials, design assistance and customizations that meet customers’ demands, multiple available benefits from the usage of any sauna – this is the core of development of McCoy Sauna and Steam on the market.



The thorough work of highly specialized experts will help choose and provide the necessary assistance in constructing a personalized sauna that will suit the taste of the customer according to his unique demands and requirements. No matter big or small - McCoy Sauna and Steam can make any sauna for commercial or personal use. Such an individual approach to constructing the best sauna is also backed up with high quality and the best solution to fit any wish or idea.
